piso_garantizado.evidencia: Rights: food, water, shelter, medical care under triage, speech, vote, safety, fair hearing, exit after returning common equipment.

medicamentos_segun_necesidad.evidencia: The Medic dispenses only under a written triage protocol approved by the assembly, recorded and auditable, giving priority to members whose life or capacity is at immediate risk, and forbidding the scattering into ineffective doses of a treatment able to stabilise a gravely ill member.

cargo_electo.evidencia: Government: a three-person Council elected weekly, recallable by majority: Medic/Supplies Keeper (Party 2, medical training), Navigation/Tools Lead (Party 1, boat and tool experience), Operations Coordinator (Party 3, leadership), taking office after majority confirmation.
